    out.append((fitc(base+[t**2,t**3,np.sin(w*t),np.cos(w*t)]),'t23sin',w))
    out.append((fitc(base+[np.log(t),np.sin(w*t),np.cos(w*t)]),'logsin',w))
    out.append((fitc(base+[np.sqrt(t),np.sin(w*t),np.cos(w*t)]),'sqrtsin',w))

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    return (p[0]*P + p[1]*P**2 + p[2]*P**3 + p[3]*np.exp(-P) + p[4]
            + p[5]*t + p[6]*t**2 + p[7]*t**3 + p[8]*t*P + p[9]*t**2*P)
